description: Lists files in any saved strategy revision owned by the authenticated user. Folders are represented by slash-separated file paths. For the current attached/open strategy, omit strategyId and revisionId so the server uses the latest active revision from conversation state, falling back to the MCP token, instead of making you copy UUIDs. If the user explicitly asks for another owned strategy, resolve that target with list_strategies/list_revisions and pass that target strategyId/revisionId here. For plan-driven first-build work, make the visible implementation item in_progress with update_plan_item before using file tools so the user sees the current plan step while file work runs. For first-build strategy work, call create_strategy first. When create_strategy attaches the workspace through conversationUpdate, omit strategyId and revisionId: get_file needs only path and list_files needs no selectors. If creation returned no conversationUpdate, copy the exact returned strategyId/revisionId pair.

revisionId.description: Revision id. Omit only for the current attached/open strategy when the MCP token is scoped to an active strategy revision.

strategyId.description: Strategy id. Omit only for the current attached/open strategy when the MCP token is scoped to an active strategy revision.

name: list_files
title: List strategy revision files
